meta_description_if_available: We invite you to come explore the Person and work of the Holy Spirit. meta_description_if_available: LENT 2024: TRUE FASTING   from ACNA’s Matthew 25 Initiative  At the Matthew 25 Initiative, our desire is to see the unseen and the marginalized treasured.  And this Lenten season, we will be telling the stories of the least of these through 40 days of Anglican-informed, inspiring, beautiful, and theologically robust engagement pieces — in the vein of the church's traditional disciplines of Lent:  prayer, fasting, and almsgiving.  For our third year of Lent, we once again invite you to join us on a journey of normalizing Anglican justice and mercy by thoughtfully engaging in this historic Christian season of prayer, fasting, and almsgiving – this time, through the lens of Isaiah 58:6-12.  Check it out   here  .  It is a free devotional you can sign up to have delivered directly to your email each day.

meta_description_if_available: After a Virtual VBS in 2020, Vacation Bible School has been on location at All Saints’ Church since 2021! VBS is open to all children in the community, and special invitations were made to those attending our monthly Food Giveaways, and Story Time at the Park. The format of Vacation Bible School at All Saints’ Church allows children to be in small groups (called crews) that they travel around the building with all week! Bible points for each day make the Gospel message easy to understand for children who don’t attend a local church. VBS volunteers serve in all different areas throughout the week, and members of the community are welcomed into our beautiful building.

meta_description_if_available: Story Time in the Park is a tangible way that All Saints’ Church is reaching the surrounding Dale City Community families. Starting in 2020 with various locations, Story Time now takes place every week at Cloverdale Park. Children’s Ministry Director, Tara Pedersen, has been able to form relationships with moms and children who see Story Time taking place Thursday mornings, and join in to participate as well. These relationships have led to families attending (and serving) in Vacation Bible School, and participating in Sunday morning activities. Story Time in the Park promotes literacy and the benefits of reading to children. It also provides snacks and an educational craft for all children who attend.

meta_description_if_available: Bitter & Sweet: A Journey Into Easter   by Tsh Oxenreider   In a world that celebrates indulging our whims whenever we want, practicing the traditions of Lent is countercultural. When we welcome the temporary suffering of Lent, we swim upstream in a culture that goes with the flow.  The practice isn’t about proving our worth or earning God’s love; it’s about remembering how dependent we are on our Maker while we live here in our temporary, fragile bodies.

meta_description_if_available: A lovely and simple resource for families to find simple ways to create meaning for the Lent season. Intended to encourage and interactively share Lent with simplicity, families will find dozens of fun and easy practices for celebrating the Easter season with our kids. The practices and seasonal prayers are grouped into chapters titled Ash Wednesday, Symbols, Lenten Prayers, Lenten Refraining, Lenten Acts of Service, Holy Week, Easter Vigil and Easter Day, and the Season of Resurrection.    Paperback from Amazon $9.29
